name: swipe
title: Swipe
description: A row that slides aside to show what can be done to it.
use: A row of a list on a touch screen that has one or two frequent actions: archive, delete, mark as read. The row is a scroller with two snap points, so a finger, a trackpad and the Tab key all reach the actions. Swiping is a shortcut and never the only way: offer the same actions in a menu or on the opened item.

instead.when: The actions must be found with a mouse, or there are more than three
The rows are slides to look at, not things to act on

keyboard.action: Moves to the first action; the browser scrolls the actions into view as it takes focus

platform.fallback: The actions do not fade in as they are uncovered: they are simply there behind the row

classes.name: swipe
classes.description: The row: a horizontal scroller with no scrollbar that rests on its content or on its actions

classes.name: swipe-content
classes.description: What the row shows at rest, as wide as the row, on the color of the surface it lies on

classes.name: swipe-actions
classes.description: The actions behind the end edge, in a well

classes.name: swipe-action
classes.description: One action, on a button or a link: a word, or an icon over a word, in a cell at least 72px wide and as tall as the row

classes.name: swipe-action-danger
classes.description: The action that cannot be undone, in the danger ink on its own tint
